HERO_META_ROLES.uses: Hero header metadata painter: colours meta row n with HERO_META_ROLES[n % 3] (hero_header.rs). The three colours hero headers already used, defined once so destinations cannot style metadata.

HINT_CHIPS.uses: Library Hero overlay display-only hint chips, rotated by chip index (widgets.rs hint pills). Chip surfaces, not text roles, so a text-colour edit cannot move them.

roles.name: TextPrimary
roles.uses: Primary readable content foreground.

roles.name: TextSecondary
roles.uses: Secondary text; pairs with TextPrimary/TextStrong; also HERO_META_ROLES[2].

roles.name: TextMuted
roles.uses: Dim text, icons, unfocused state; unselected library tab and pill-chip text; played/watched media-list row titles (chrome_tabs.rs, slots.rs, widgets.rs, queue.rs, search_sidebar.rs, media_list/row.rs).

roles.name: TextStrong
roles.uses: Bold titles/headings (warm white).

roles.name: TextEmphasis
roles.uses: Warm emphasis text: focused rows, dialogs; also the split-row context colour's backing value.

roles.name: TabSelectedUnderline
roles.uses: The selected tab's underline run in the tab bar: upper-eighth blocks on the row below the tab text, spanning exactly the selected title (chrome_tabs.rs). Experimenting with Mauve; replaced the underline's original TextEmphasis value.

roles.name: TextFocusAccent
roles.uses: Focused-row title accent; queue selected-scope text; paused status; home-video marker; visualizer mid band; status-bar time.

roles.name: TextHeroTitle
roles.uses: Hero header title (first metadata line). Same value as focus accent, separate role.

roles.name: WorkspaceHeaderFg
roles.uses: Workspace box header label (TRACKLIST) in a music album Hero (hero_composition.rs). Own role over the metadata blue (TextMetadata; the selected pill chip shares the slot): equal today, independently editable.

roles.name: TextOnAccent
roles.uses: Near-black text painted on a coloured surface: context-menu selected row, indicator badges, hint pills.

roles.name: TextAccentMuted
roles.uses: Loaded/playing/confirmed value text (library_routes.rs, multiselect.rs). Own role over the focused-surface slot (Bg2): equal today, independently editable.

roles.name: PlaylistLoadedFg
roles.uses: Loaded-playlist marker in the F4 playlists list (playlists.rs). Own role over ProgressPercent: equal today, independently editable.

roles.name: TextDetailMeta
roles.uses: Detail-screen label/meta text; HERO_META_ROLES[0].

roles.name: TextMetadata
roles.uses: Secondary metadata: durations and badges; HERO_META_ROLES[1]. Also the grouped-list heading label and the hovered hero link.

roles.name: SelectedRowFg
roles.uses: Selected-row text on the selection bar: the media-list marker and the music tree's selected label (music_tree_label.rs, media_list/row.rs). Its own role keeps the bar's foreground independent of the title and metadata hierarchy.

roles.name: SelectedRowProgressFg
roles.uses: The resume-progress percentage on a selected row (media_list/row.rs): the bar's darker companion to SelectedRowFg, because the ordinary progress orange does not read on the light bar. Shares its slot with the resting surface fills; independently editable.

roles.name: StatusError
roles.uses: Error status text.

roles.name: StatusAvailable
roles.uses: Checkmarks, available/positive metadata (queue_playback.rs).

roles.name: Duration
roles.uses: Right-aligned duration column of the Queue list only. Own role so a status-colour edit cannot move durations. Library browse rows carry no time.

roles.name: SplitRowContextFg
roles.uses: Split media-list row primary/context part (podcast an episode came from). Soft white; the playback strip keeps gold.

roles.name: SplitRowTitleFg
roles.uses: Split media-list row secondary/item title. Light grey; the playback strip keeps aqua.

roles.name: IndicatorResolutionFg
roles.uses: Resolution glyph foreground (indicators.rs).

roles.name: IndicatorAudioFg
roles.uses: Audio glyph foreground (indicators.rs).

roles.name: PlaybackValueFg
roles.uses: Now-playing title/codec value.

roles.name: PlaybackMetaFg
roles.uses: Playback metadata captions/time.

roles.name: PlaybackTitleFg
roles.uses: Now-playing title row item name. Own role over Accent: equal today, independently editable (now-playing-media-type-titles D2).

roles.name: PlaybackContextFg
roles.uses: Now-playing title row container (series/artist/show/subscription). Own role over the focused-row accent: equal today, independently editable (now-playing-media-type-titles D2).

roles.name: ProgressTrack
roles.uses: Unplayed seek/progress track.

roles.name: ProgressPercent
roles.uses: Resume-progress percentage text of a media-list row and of a hero metadata row (media_list/row.rs, hero_header.rs). Own role over the metadata blue it used to take and over IndicatorResolutionFg: equal today, independently editable.

roles.name: GroupHeadingFg
roles.uses: Group-heading rows in embedded media lists (media_list/row.rs). Own role over TextMetadata: equal today, independently editable.

roles.name: Scrollbar
roles.uses: Library/chrome scrollbar track/thumb. Shares its slot (Bg3) with the focused content-body sheet; independently editable.

roles.name: SidebarScrollbar
roles.uses: Sidebar scrollbar track/thumb (chrome.rs). Own role over TextMuted: the sidebar bodies paint the scrollbar's own Bg3 slot, so it shares dim-text grey instead.

roles.name: HeroOverviewSeparator
roles.uses: Overview/credits separator line in hero/overview painters (widgets.rs, overview_box tests).

roles.name: HeroCreditsName
roles.uses: Credits name-column foreground (overview_box.rs).

roles.name: Accent
roles.uses: Focus accent: watched indicators, folder/row icons, Emby brand glyph, queue scope-pill selected (Direct-remote aqua), visualizer low band, play icon, settings highlights, status-bar pill.

roles.name: AccentActive
roles.uses: Active tab, focused pill/badge text, context-menu selected row, playlist/session selected markers, home-video secondary marker, search-sidebar marker.

roles.name: AccentAudiobookshelf
roles.uses: Audiobookshelf brand glyph (chrome_status.rs).

roles.name: PillSelectedFg
roles.uses: Selected pill-chip foreground text on the blue fill (slots.rs, widgets.rs, search_sidebar.rs).

roles.name: PillOverflowFg
roles.uses: Pill-selector overflow/edge accent (widgets.rs). Shares TextAccentMuted's slot (Bg2): equal today, independently editable.

specials.name: Color::Black
specials.uses: Popup dim-backdrop blend base (backdrop.rs dims every cell halfway toward black). Not a palette fill.

specials.name: Color::White
specials.uses: Status-bar pills (status_bar_panel.rs), chrome_status headings. Raw ratatui named colour, not a theme role.

specials.name: Color::Reset
specials.uses: Transparent/unpainted cells: media-list gutters, marquee parts, card-painter tests. Means 'no fill', not a colour.

surfaces.name: ArtworkLoadingPlaceholder
surfaces.uses: Artwork-loading inset fill (card.rs, album_art.rs, hero painters). Own fill over TextMuted's slot (FgMuted): equal today, independently editable.

surfaces.name: ArtworkPlaceholder
surfaces.uses: No-artwork surface; fixed backdrop.

surfaces.name: CreditsStripe
surfaces.uses: Alternating credits-row stripe background (overview_box.rs); the HeroCreditsStripe role's identity, folded into the table.

surfaces.name: HeroPane
surfaces.uses: Wide hero right pane / Library Hero overlay sheet: the dark chrome the hero content repaints its own background with, fixed in both focus states (wide_hero.rs, hero overlay). Was focus-reactive content before the 2026-09-20 sheet decision.

surfaces.name: HintChip0
surfaces.uses: Library Hero overlay's first display-only hint chip (widgets.rs). One of three chip surfaces (HINT_CHIPS), rotated by chip index; chip surfaces, not text roles, so a text-colour edit cannot move them.

surfaces.name: HintChip1
surfaces.uses: Library Hero overlay's second display-only hint chip (widgets.rs). One of three chip surfaces (HINT_CHIPS), rotated by chip index; chip surfaces, not text roles, so a text-colour edit cannot move them.

surfaces.name: HintChip2
surfaces.uses: Library Hero overlay's third display-only hint chip (widgets.rs). One of three chip surfaces (HINT_CHIPS), rotated by chip index; chip surfaces, not text roles, so a text-colour edit cannot move them.

surfaces.name: LibraryColumn
surfaces.uses: Library column gutter + wide Music browser container; follows the library panel's own focus bit — focused the column fill, resting the app backdrop (shell_library_panel.rs library_body_fill).

surfaces.name: LibraryPanel
surfaces.uses: Wide-hero rail body + frame across Movies/TV/Music/ABS/Feeds/Home (browser paint, tv_wide, music_wide, feeds, home); focused it takes the lighter content-body sheet (Bg3).

surfaces.name: ListStripe
surfaces.uses: The secondary zebra stripe shared by the F4 playlists list (playlists.rs), the settings/keys list (settings_component.rs) and the F3 sessions sidebar list (three_line_flat_list.rs): one concept, one identity. Its value is the focused-surface green the three stripe roles shared.

surfaces.name: MainContentBox
surfaces.uses: Pane content box: TV episode listing, Music track listing, generic pane inset (tv_wide, music_wide, wide_hero); the focused TV Workspace body shares the row (hero_composition.rs).

surfaces.name: ModalButton
surfaces.uses: The confirm modal's buttons (confirm_modal.rs); fixed chrome ink in both focus states.

surfaces.name: PillChip
surfaces.uses: Unselected pill chip (scroll-pills tests); fixed chrome ink.

surfaces.name: PillChipSelected
surfaces.uses: Selected library pill chip (slots.rs, search_sidebar.rs); fixed blue. Its own fill over TextMetadata's slot: equal today, independently editable.

surfaces.name: PillRow
surfaces.uses: Pill selector row band (scroll-pills tests); fixed chrome ink.

surfaces.name: PillRowGap
surfaces.uses: Selector-row spacer band (home.rs, library panel selector row): the panel showing through, so it follows the panel's own focus bit — the one chrome band that does.

surfaces.name: PlaybackPanel
surfaces.uses: Now-playing panel body (shell_playback projection, playback.rs default).

surfaces.name: PlaybackStatusPill
surfaces.uses: Playback status pill inset; fixed backdrop.

surfaces.name: PopupBorder
surfaces.uses: The modal frame's border rule (modal_frame.rs); shares the resting fill's slot (Bg1).

surfaces.name: PopupFrame
surfaces.uses: Every modal frame background (modal_frame.rs); fixed.

surfaces.name: QueueCardVisualizer
surfaces.uses: Queue card visualizer slot: fills the same chrome band the queue playback panel paints, fixed in both focus states so the reserved slot never flashes a fill the panel around it does not have (card.rs).

surfaces.name: QueueColumn
surfaces.uses: Queue column gutter + queue boundary strip; follows queue-column focus.

surfaces.name: QueueOnlyPlaybackPanel
surfaces.uses: Queue-only mode playback strip (shell_draw.rs): no right column, paints chrome in both states. Mode-driven, not focus-driven.

surfaces.name: QueuePanel
surfaces.uses: Queue panel body (widgets.rs); focused the lighter sheet (Bg3), backdrop resting.

surfaces.name: QueuePanelBand
surfaces.uses: Queue panel header/status band (queue.rs); fixed.

surfaces.name: QueueScopePillSelected
surfaces.uses: Queue selected scope pill; fixed Accent aqua = Direct-remote indicator (queue.rs), not library-pill blue.

surfaces.name: SelectedRow
surfaces.uses: The selection bar: media-list, tree-browser, playlist and session selected rows, and the popup context menu's selected row (media_list/wide.rs, tree_browser.rs, playlists.rs, three_line_flat_list.rs, context_menu.rs). Rows keep ordinary foreground roles on the bar (SelectedRowFg for the bar's own text). Shares its slot (Green) with AccentActive, HeroOverviewSeparator, Duration and the playback value roles; independently editable.

surfaces.name: SidebarBand
surfaces.uses: Sidebar header/footer band; fixed.

surfaces.name: SidebarBody
surfaces.uses: Expanded (F1-F4) sidebar body (chrome.rs panel shell content area; the header/footer band keeps its own ink); fixed in both focus states. Its own fill over the Scrollbar role's slot (Bg3): equal today, independently editable.

surfaces.name: StatusBar
surfaces.uses: Status bar band (chrome_status.rs); fixed.

surfaces.name: StatusBarPill
surfaces.uses: Status bar pill inset; fixed.

surfaces.name: TabBar
surfaces.uses: Tab bar band (chrome_tabs.rs); fixed.

surfaces.name: TransportRow
surfaces.uses: The queue transport row background and the seek gauge background (queue_band.rs); shares the app-backdrop slot (Bg0).

surfaces.name: WorkspaceStripe
surfaces.uses: The TV Workspace list's secondary zebra stripe (panel_list.rs WideWorkspace): the stripe the focused Workspace's rows alternate against. Resting shares the queue column's resting fill.
